source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting reportable workplace accidents

1. Start with the incident records.
2.
completion:
Review any witnesses that saw the incident occur.
3. List all employees involved in the incident.
4. List the employees that were needed to resolve or assist in resolving the incident.
5. List the type of injury or illness.
6. List the part of the body affected.
7. List the source of the injury or illness.
8. List the event or exposure that caused the injury/illness.
9. List any secondary events that may have contributed to the incident.
10. List how the work activities were being performed when the incident occurred.
11. List all equipment used and involved in the incident.
